title: A Short History Of Nearly Everything

questions.q: How long did it take to create most of the universe, per lesson 1?
What is a singularity, according to the summary?
a: A moment where nothing is defined and everything is unpredictable
questions.why: Lesson 1 defines a singularity this way.

questions.q: What share of earth's habitable space is unsuited for humans?
questions.why: Lesson 2 gives 99.5% since it's water or lacks oxygen.

questions.q: What role does the moon play for a livable planet?
a: Keeps gravity in check so it spins at the right speed and angle
questions.why: Lesson 2 lists a moon as a requirement for balanced spin.

questions.q: How many asteroids are described as large enough to wipe us out?
questions.why: Lesson 3 says 2,000 are large enough for total destruction.
